claims.baseline_v1: historically known local opponent excluded from F35 training/demonstrations; not unseen opponent family
claims.causal_scope: effect of one fixed offline demonstration auxiliary-loss package conditional on F34 states/shared corpus and schedules; shared-trunk feedback and extra compute not isolated
claims.generalization: fresh development games with recurring official generation, not held-out species/unordered teams/public strength; G2/G3/G4 remain open

execution.scope: One separately authorized fresh attempt with the user-approved 2026-10-28T18:00:00Z cutoff. Original start/checkpoint, seeds and budgets remain unchanged. F35 and F36 remain failed; no partial corpus, game, learner state or evaluation reuse.

teacher_policy.authoritative_mask_source: current player projection from Showdown coordinator
teacher_policy.forced_singleton: choose the sole advertised action without native search or RNG sampling
teacher_policy.multiple_actions: aggregate native root action mass, filter to authoritative legal actions before the existing 75-percent threshold, then perform one RNG choice
teacher_policy.no_legal_mass: fail closed without fallback, retry, resampling or game replacement
teacher_policy.raw_response_journal: flush raw teacher response before label validation or simulator submission
teacher_policy.scope: Adapted Foul Play teacher with authoritative request legality; distinct from the unmodified native teacher.

failure_policy: Stop fixed scientific workflow on failure; no restart, stitch, dropped cell, game replacement, outcome-dependent budget change or substitute easier comparison. Preserve partial evidence. Stop launching at deadline.

statistics.gate: cutoff-aware lower point gain>=0.05 and approximate family-adjusted bootstrap lower bound>0 and both final arm cutoff rates<=0.05
statistics.limitations: low power; failure of the conjunction is not proof of no benefit; intervals and all contrasts retained
statistics.overall_gate: all three baseline primary per-seed gates; teacher adaptation separate
statistics.pairing: common ordered team pair and mechanics seed across arms, both seats form one resampled cluster; unseeded teacher-search randomness remains
statistics.primary: assisted-final minus control-final baseline-v1 separately for all three seeds
statistics.secondary: assisted-final minus control-final Foul Play separately for all three seeds

teacher_data.rejected_action_policy: restore pre-choice last_selected_move on exact feedback before next protocol ingestion; retain rejected attempt; never replace game
teacher_data.unsupported_active_action_policy: fail closed, preserve whole failed execution; waiting frames are counted without labels

verification.scope: sampled fresh games/recorded accepted teacher actions, original-next-update and explicit unavailable-choice fixture; not exhaustive replay or repeated teacher search
